# Support

Use the right channel so maintainers can respond efficiently:

- **Usage questions and ideas:** [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/zoxilsi/studio/discussions)
- **Reproducible bugs:** [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/zoxilsi/studio/issues/new/choose)
- **Security vulnerabilities:** follow [the security policy](SECURITY.md)

Newcomers and first-time open-source contributors are welcome. It is okay if
you are not sure whether something is a question, bug, or feature idea—start a
Discussion and the community can help route it.

This is a community-maintained project, so response times are best effort.
Helpful answers from other community members are always appreciated.
